owner: Kepstar Data Centre Management Co., Ltd
notes: Inaugural Kepstar facility at 216 Norodom Blvd, Phnom Penh; W.Media (Nov 2022) reported Kepstar launching 'Cambodia's 1st Tier III data center'. Company profile (DataCenterMap, B/C) describes first phase of a pair of carrier-neutral DCs with combined ~6.8 MW and 1,200 racks in 110,000 sq ft. Baxtel lists Kepstar Phnom Penh ~7 MW (C). DC2 site ~100 km from Phnom Penh, province not confirmed.
